tasks.subject: Task 1: Fix the endpoint in the B-spline basis
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A query at the exact maximum of any axis evaluates correctly, and a fitted surface no longer collapses across the top knot span.

**Files:**
- Modify: `calibrate/src/correction_surface.rs` — `bspline_basis` (~line 408) and the `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` block (~line 1096)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Partition of unity holds to 1e-12 at every corner and face of the domain, including all three axes at max simultaneously
- No regression at interior points or axis minima
- A surface *fitted* to a known constant recovers it at the domain maximum, not just interior
- Existing calibrate suite passes unchanged
- antenna-model tests pass unchanged

**Verify:** `cargo test -p calibrate --lib correction_surface -- --nocapture` → all pass including three new tests

**Steps:** Add three failing tests (partition of unity at every face/corner, continuity up to the max, a fitted constant recovered at the max) plus `clamped_knots`/`unit_surface` helpers — full code in the plan. Run; if any PASSES before the fix, STOP and report, the reproduction has drifted. Fix the `k == 1` base case with a branch returning 1.0 when `t == knots[knots.len()-1] && knots[i+1] == t && knots[i] < knots[i+1]`; leave the recursive case alone. Run both crates' tests. fmt, clippy, commit.

Root cause: half-open base case means no basis function is non-zero at `t_max`; the existing special case keys on `i == knots.len() - 2`, a padding index outside the valid basis range for a clamped vector. The damaging half is in FITTING — the same basis is used by `accumulate_normal_equations`, so max-edge measurements contributed all-zero rows and starved the last coefficient.

tasks.subject: Task 2: Re-measure and tighten D12's tolerances
tasks.description:
**Goal:** D12's two deliberately weakened assertions are tightened to what the fixed fitter actually achieves.

**Files:**
- Modify: `calibrate/tests/cli_full_mode_e2e.rs` — the improvement ceiling in `cli_full_mode_correction_beats_the_uncorrected_model` and `BIAS_RECOVERY_TOLERANCE_DB`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Before and after values recorded in the commit message
- Improvement ceiling tightened to just above the new corrected_rmse
- BIAS_RECOVERY_TOLERANCE_DB tightened to just above the new worst-case probe error
- Both doc comments rewritten to name the remaining limit, not the fixed one
- Suite passes: 11 passed, 1 ignored

**Verify:** `cargo test -p calibrate --test cli_full_mode_e2e -- --nocapture` → 11 passed, 1 ignored

**Steps:** Measure. Pre-fix: model-only 1.3071, corrected 0.9756; probes 0.5928/0.0934/0.0365/0.0934; ceiling 0.9756+0.02; tolerance 0.65. Two tests WILL fail — both are upper bounds pinned to the old worse numbers; that is the fix working. Tighten the ceiling to new corrected + 0.02 absolute (keep absolute: deterministic to 4 decimals, epsilon covers libm ULP). Tighten the tolerance ~10% above the new worst case. SANITY CHECK: injected bias at the probes is 1.4529/0.8667/0.7529/1.0291 — if the new tolerance exceeds 0.7529 the test can't distinguish fitted-well from fitted-nothing; say so and STOP. check.sh, commit with real values.

tasks.subject: Task 3: Correct the findings doc and update the roadmap
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The findings doc stops asserting something false about the service-side interpolator, and the roadmap records the fix.

**Files:**
- Modify: `docs/findings-2026-07-29-correction-surface-upper-edge-collapse.md`
- Modify: `docs/roadmap-2026-07.md` — section 7 risk entry added by D12
- Modify: `docs/roadmap-2026-07-work-units.md` — add the unit, mark it done

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- No claim that the service-side 4D evaluate_correction is defective
- Real mechanism recorded, plus the partition-of-unity evidence that the 4D interpolator is correct
- RESOLVED header naming the fixing commit
- Section 7 risk retired with a resolution note
- The two out-of-scope items still listed open with reasons
- No claim the system is now well-determined

**Verify:** `grep -n 'service-side 4D' docs/findings-2026-07-29-correction-surface-upper-edge-collapse.md` → remaining mentions say correct, not defective; `./scripts/check.sh` → All gate checks passed.

**Steps:** Add RESOLVED block. Replace the "same behavior" claim with the verified truth (standard NURBS Cox-de Boor + correctly clamping find_knot_span; partition of unity 1.000000000 at every boundary including all four axes at max with hand-built coefficients; apparent failure was inherited corrupted coefficients). Correct/remove the 4D reproduction rows. Revise "Why it went unnoticed" point 1 — round-trip passed because coefficients were shared, not because both algorithms were wrong; interior-only sampling still stands. KEEP the refuted-hypotheses section. Retire the section 7 risk but NOT what remains true (underdetermined, tuner broken, no .bin ships). Add a Phase 4 unit section in the D10/D11/D12 voice.
